notes:
Debug-signed dev build for sideloading (not for Play).

Backend: none (on-device only); licenses from https://staging-pay.g3tech.net (Stripe test mode)

New: a 14-day trial. After it, saved cuts still open and play; making new cuts and exporting need a license key (Buy Snow Cut / Enter license key in About). Android APK and Windows installer.

Changes since the last release (c00177a):

- chore(release): skicut 0.1.5 (a3fb11a)
- build(deps): lock g3-payments with the Android TLS fix (654b582)
- build(deps): lock g3-payments for the license feature (4414d98)
- feat(app): 14-day trial and license keys through g3-payments (846d97e)
- build(deps): commit a lockfile that resolves without local overrides (0f86fc1)
- build: take dioxus-sdk-time from the Gateway3B fork (908cb1c)
- style: rustfmt under the repo's 2024 settings (267e31e)
- chore(release): skicut 0.1.4 (68e9d29)
